once the grid is open, fill it using the numbers 1 to 9, treating each digit like a vital gas that fuels the logic of the puzzle.

remember that each number must appear just once in every row, column and 3x3 box, a rule that adds a temporary twist to the strategy, keeping the solution fresh and engaging.

if you want to verify your work, buy next week’s Observer Digital Edition to see the completed puzzle, a reward that feels as satisfying as lifting a light weight after a good mental workout."
